name: Mech
description: A pilotable mech, about three and a half blocks tall, in teal armour with mint enamel and steel trim: a broad chest that comes to a prow, big angular shoulders, a steel V crest on its brow and two thrusters on its back. Its trunk is a bay you stand in, back against a harness, looking out through the visor of its head. You climb in, and it walks, jumps and punches for you.
